    cnt={}
    for row in g: cnt={k:v for k,v in [(v,c)]} 
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)

    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dirs={'TL':(-1,-1),'TR':(-1,1),'BL':(1,-1),'BR':(1,1)}
    for r in range(H-1):
        for c in range(W-1):
            pts=[(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1)]
            vals=[g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in pts]
            empt=vals.index(bg)
            if vals.count(bg)!=1: continue
            miss=(pts[empt]); col=g[pts[(empt+1)%4][0]][pts[(empt+1)%4][1]]
            # other three must be same color
            oth=other([i for i in range(4)],empt)[0]

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    pts=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]
    dirs=[(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]
    for r in range(H-1):
        for c in range(W-1):
            vals=[g[r+i][c+j] for i,j in pts]
            if vals.count(bg)!=1: continue
            em=vals.index(bg)
            oth={v for v in vals if v!=bg}
            if len(oth)!=1: continue
            col=oth.pop()
            ho=(r+pts[em][0], c+pts[em][1])
            # paint ONLY ALONG ONE diagonal: choose the diagonal whose continuation inside/outside aligns... 
            # Hypothesis A: shoot from hole along BOTH diagonals but only the one pointing AWAY from block interior? Both leave block.
            # Hypothesis B: direction = away from the shape's filled corner. The opposite corner of the block IS the hole. Ray leaves from the two cells ADJACENT to hole (orthogonally)? 
            # Look at data: window (2,15,col3,ho=(2,16)): expected paints along r+c? expected diff near: (1,12),(2,11) belong to r+c=13 with window? (2,11) is hole of window(2,10). Hmm.
            # Try: ray starts at hole, goes in direction opposite to the SHAPE centroid. Centroid approx = hole + (mi,mj)/2 toward other cells? Other cells occupy quadrant towards (1-mi,1-mj)? No—other cells are at positions excluding hole.
            # Simplest robust guess: direction signs equal to -(sign toward other cells). Other three cells surround hole from sides; take net direction = sign(majority offset).
            offsets=[(p[0]-ho[0], p[1]-ho[1]) for p in [(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c)] ]
            sr=sum(p[0] for p in offsets)//3; sc=sum(p[1] for p in offsets)//3
            dr,dj=(-sr if sr else -1, -sc if sc else -1)
            rr,cc=ho[0]+dr,ho[1]+dj
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and out[rr][cc]==bg:
                out[rr][cc]=col; rr+=dr; cc+=dj
    return out

def windows(g,bg):
    res=[]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H-1):
        for c in range(W-1):
            vals=[g[r+i][c+j] for i,j in pts]
            if vals.count(bg)!=1: continue
            oth={v for v in vals if v!=bg}
            if len(oth)!=1: continue
            em=vals.index(bg); col=oth.pop()
            ho=(r+pts[em][0], c+pts[em][1])
            offs=[(r+pts[i][0]-ho[0], c+pts[i][1]-ho[1]) for i in range(4) if vals[i]!=bg]
            sr=sum(p[0] for p in offs)/3; sc=sum(p[1] for p in offs)/3
            dr=-int(sr) if sr else -1; dc=-int(sc) if sc else -1
            path=[]; rr,cc=ho[0]+dr,ho[1]+dc
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bg:
                path.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            res.append((col,path))
    return res

def diagonals_from_cell(I,O,bg):
    hits=[]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    for ci in range(H):
        for cj in range(W):
            c=I[ci][cj]
            if c==bg: continue
            for d in [(1,1),(1,-1)]:
                # forward ray
                fwd=[]
                i,j=ci,cj
                while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and O[i][j]==c:
                    fwd.append((i,j)); i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
                bwd=[]
                i,j=ci,cj
                while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and O[i][j]==c:
                    bwd.append((i,j)); i-=d[0]; j-=d[1]
                seg=bwd[::-1]+fwd
                # full diagonal extent from source cell
                ful=[(ci,dj) for dj in range(max(0,cj-d[1]), min(W-1, cj+d[1]))] if False else None
                ful=[]
                i,j=ci,cj
                for sgn in (1,-1):
                    ii,jj=i,j
                    while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W:
                        ful.append((ii,jj)); ii+=sgn*d[0]; jj+=sgn*d[1]
                # keep maximal contiguous same-color run in O that CONTAINS source cell
                run=[(ci,cj)]
                for sgn in (1,-1):
                    ii,jj=ci+sgn*d[0],cj+sgn*d[1]
                    while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W and O[ii][jj]==c:
                        run.append((ii,jj)); ii+=sgn*d[0]; jj+=sgn*d[1]
                # check whether THIS run is wholly added (no input cell of this color inside except source?) 
                inp=[p for p in run if I[p[0]][p[1]]==c and p!=(ci,cj)]
                added_flag=all(O[p[0]][p[1]]==c and I[p[0]][p[1]]!=c for p in run[1:])
                hits.append((c,run,added_flag,len(inp)))
    return hits

# Hypothesis H: each component (L-tromino-ish shape) is a corner piece of a 2x2 block.
# The empty cell of its 2x2 block is the "seed"; from that seed, extend a diagonal RAY
# (both dirs? or one?) painting the color over background cells until blocked by a non-bg cell or edge.
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,c):
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==c]
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            for di in (-1,0,1):
                for dj in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(q[0]+di,q[1]+dj)
                    if n in pts and n not in seen: st.append(n)
        res.append(sorted(comp))
    return res
from collections import Counter
def predict(I):
    g=[r[:] for r in I]
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in I for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts={p for cc in comps(I,bg) for p in cc}
    for c in sorted(set(sum([list(r_) for r_ in I],[]))-{bg}):
        for comp in comps(I,c):
            cells=set(comp)
            # find 2x2 bbox containing comp
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0!=1 or c1-c0!=1: continue
            miss=[(rr,cc) for rr in (r0,r1) for cc in (c0,c1) if (rr,cc) not in cells]
            if len(miss)!=1: continue
            mi,mj=miss[0]
            # diagonal directions from seed into empty quadrant
            dirs=[]
            for dr in (-1,1):
                for dc in (-1,1):
                    pass
            # determine which diagonal quadrant: the seed (mi,mj) relative to shape
            # shape occupies other 3 corners; the two leg directions from seed
            legdir_r = -1 if (mi+1,mj) in cells else 1   # which vertical neighbor belongs to shape
            legdir_c = -1 if (mi,mj+1) in cells else 1
            # ray goes opposite: away from both legs? or along? try both combos later
            cand=[(legdir_r,legdir_c),(-legdir_r,-legdir_c)]
            # also perpendicular diagonals
            perp=[(legdir_c,legdir_r),(-legdir_c,-legdir_r)]
            return g,comp,miss,cand,perp
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[k+' input']
    bg=Counter(x for r_ in I for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print('==',k,'bg',bg)
    nshape=0
    for c in sorted(set(sum([list(r_) for r_ in I],[]))-{bg}):
        for comp in comps(I,c):
            cells=set(comp)
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            if max(rs)-min(rs)!=1 or max(cs)-min(cs)!=1: continue
            miss=[(rr,cc) for rr in (min(rs),max(rs)) for cc in (min(cs),max(cs)) if (rr,cc) not in cells]
            if len(miss)!=1: continue
            mi,mj=miss[0]
            lr = 1 if (mi-1,mj) in cells else -1
            lc = 1 if (mi,mj-1) in cells else -1
            # ray directions (dr,dc): candidates = opposite of legs (lr,lc) and (lc,lr)
            cands=[(-lr,-lc),(-lc,-lr),(lr,lc),(lc,lr)]
            # paint rays from (mi,mj) in each candidate dir while bg and in bounds
            painted=set()
            for dr,dc in cands:
                ii,jj=mi+dr,mj+dc
                while 0<=ii<len(I) and 0<=jj<len(I[0]) and I[ii][jj]==bg:
                    painted.add((ii,jj)); ii+=dr; jj+=dc
            ok=all(painted<=set((i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j] and G[k+' output'][i][j]==c) for c2,c3 in [(c,1)] ) if False else None
            print(' color',c,'seed',(mi,mj),'legdirs',(lr,lc),'raysize',len(painted),'match-ok:',painted<=set((i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=G[k+' output'][i][j] or G[k+' output'][i][j]!=c))
            nshape+=1
    print('shapes processed',nshape)

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
